script_text: Gemini, your restless air element finally gets oxygen this week, because something you've chased for seven months answers. Early week, Mercury, your ruling planet, sits in your 8th House of shared money and squares Saturn in your 5th, so Monday and Tuesday bring stalled negotiations and a partner who refuses to open up. Midweek, Mercury slips into Sagittarius and your 9th House, trine Venus, and everything loosens. By Thursday, Venus in Capricorn, your 10th House of career, trines Jupiter in your 6th, so expect recognition and a real raise conversation. Saturday, the Moon enters your 7th House and a long-distance love text arrives. Thursday is your power day because Venus trines Jupiter in your 10th House. Tuesday is your worst day; Mercury square Saturn freezes your 5th House romance. Sign nothing before Friday; let Mercury clear your 8th House first. Follow for daily cosmic updates.
